name: @hazelgrove/hazel-embed
description: React component for embedding Hazel in other applications
author: Hazel Team

scripts.type:messages: tsx node_modules/@ocsigen/ts2ocaml/dist/ts2ocaml.js jsoo --preset full --output-dir src/types src/types/messages.d.ts && cp src/types/messages.mli ../src/haz3lcore/MessageTypes.mli
scripts.type:delta: tsx node_modules/@ocsigen/ts2ocaml/dist/ts2ocaml.js jsoo --preset full --output-dir src/types src/types/delta.d.ts && cp src/types/delta.mli ../src/haz3lcore/Delta.mli
scripts.type: npm run type:messages && npm run type:delta
